+"""Reproduce the toctree special pages issue."""
+import pytest
+

+@pytest.mark.sphinx(testroot='toctree')
+def test_reproduce(app, status, warning):
+    # Add genindex, modindex, search to the toctree
+    index = (app.srcdir / 'index.rst').read_text(encoding='utf8')
+    toctree_block = """.. toctree::
+   :maxdepth: 1
+   :caption: Indices and tables
+
+   genindex
+   modindex
+   search
+"""
+    index = index.replace(
+        "Indices and tables\n==================\n\n* :ref:`genindex`\n* :ref:`modindex`\n* :ref:`search`\n",
+        "Indices and tables\n==================\n\n" + toctree_block)
+    (app.srcdir / 'index.rst').write_text(index, encoding='utf8')
+    app.build()
+    print("WARNING OUTPUT:")
+    print(warning.getvalue())
+    assert 'nonexisting document' not in warning.getvalue()
